name: Ferienwohnung Kronthaler
beschreibung:
Idylllically situated in Erl, Ferienwohnung Kronthaler provides well-kept comfort for couples and families, with a sunny balcony facing the Kaiser mountains.

Hikes up the Kranzhorn, the Tyrol Festival Erl, and cycling along the Inn River are right on your doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Kronthaler in Erl offers cosy living comfort in the festival village of Kufsteinerland.
